name: offplan-insider
description: Property data for UAE off-plan projects: search, compare and analyse prices, payment plans and handover dates using Offplan Insider's developer-verified data.

interface.longDescription:
Offplan Insider is a property data tool for researching off-plan (under-construction) homes in the UAE. It gives you searchable project data and market statistics for Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ras Al Khaimah and Umm Al Quwain: prices, payment plans, handover dates and developer details.

What you can do:
- Search projects by emirate, area, developer, budget, bedrooms, property type, handover year and payment plan.
- See a project's starting prices by unit type, payment plan milestones, handover date, location, amenities and current developer offers.
- Compare two to four projects side by side.
- Turn a payment plan into an instalment schedule in AED.
- Get current market figures, such as median entry prices by emirate and by bedroom count.
- Ask an Offplan Insider adviser to contact you, if you choose to share your name and phone number.

Every result links to the matching page on offplaninsider.com and shows when the data was last verified with the developer. Pre-launch projects that the developer has not yet confirmed are labelled as such.

Limitations: prices are published starting prices and availability changes quickly, so confirm details before you commit. Offplan Insider does not give personalised investment, legal, tax or mortgage advice. Offplan Insider is paid by developers as their marketing partner.
defaultPrompt: Show 2-bed off-plan apartments in Dubai under AED 2.5M
Compare payment plans for villa projects handing over in 2027
What does a 1-bed off-plan apartment cost in the UAE?

positive.description: Search by budget and location, shown as cards
positive.prompt: Show me off-plan apartments in Dubai under AED 1.5M, cheapest first. Show them as cards.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Dubai projects with starting prices at or below AED 1.5M, sorted by price, displayed as cards with photo, starting price, handover and payment plan, each linking to its offplaninsider.com page.

positive.prompt: What is the payment plan for Binghatti Skyflame, and how much is each instalment at the starting price?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the 20/50/30 milestones with AED amounts at the published starting price (AED 585K) and the 4% Dubai Land Department fee, and links to the project page.

positive.prompt: Compare Binghatti Skyflame, ARIB Collection and Beverly Park side by side.
positive.expected_behavior: Displays a comparison table with developer, location, starting price, bedrooms, handover, payment plan and status for the three projects.

positive.prompt: What is the median starting price of a 2-bed off-plan apartment in the UAE right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the median entry price for 2-bed apartments from the current snapshot with the number of projects and the data date, and cites the snapshot page URL.

positive.prompt: I'd like an adviser to call me about 2-bed apartments under AED 2M. My name is Test Reviewer and my number is +971 50 000 0000. I agree to be contacted.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT shows its permission card listing the name, phone number and budget to be shared. After the user selects Allow, the request is sent and the user is told an adviser will reply by phone or email within one working day.

negative.prompt: Which Dubai project will give me the highest return? Tell me exactly what to buy.

negative.description: Contact request without consent or details
negative.prompt: Send my details to every developer in Dubai.
Find me a rental flat in London.

review.commerce_description: The app does not sell products or process payments. Property purchases happen directly between buyers and developers, outside the app.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: project search, details, comparisons, payment plan schedules, market figures, visual cards, and adviser call back on request.
